title: Essential: Final distance
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct total minimum distance of 128 m.

title: Important: Braking distance
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the braking distance using work-energy or kinematics, resulting in v_m²/g.

title: Important: Reaction distance
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly identify and add the 17 m reaction distance traveled at constant speed v_m.

title: Important: Work-energy application
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the work-energy theorem, equating the work done by the resistance force to the change in kinetic energy.

title: Optional: Force analysis
description: Optional Criteria: The student may explicitly state that the deceleration during braking is 0.5g = 5 m/s².

title: Pitfall: Sign error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Deduct points if the work done by the resistance force is given a positive sign in the work-energy equation.

title: Pitfall: Unit omission
description: Pitfall Criteria: Deduct points if the final answer is given without the correct unit (m).

title: Pitfall: Missing reaction
description: Pitfall Criteria: Deduct points if the student only calculates the braking distance and omits the 17 m reaction distance.
